facts.text: I want help writing a cover letter.

I founded, led, and sold one of the leading US out of home (OOH) media networks.
I purchased, scaled, and sold a widely recognized on-air talent marketplace.
I sourced and built a network of 1000+ media personalities and influencers across industry.
I built a network of local green screen studios and freelance videographers across the world to provide a frictionless way to create content with talent regardless of location.
I designed a new revenue model and hired and managed a sales team as CRO of a VC/Angel investor startup in the primary and secondary education space.
I took a fledgling company from 0 to 1 as CRO.
I led U.S. media licensing sales for the world's leading licensing agency for rights-holders of video content.
I opened an NYC office for the licensing agency.
I signed partnership agreements with leading media companies in the thought leadership space.
I worked as a Partnerships and Growth Consultant at Compose.AI from January 2021 to August 2022.
I was a growth advisor for a seed round funded San Francisco start-up.
I handled media production and advertising during ramp-up.
I worked as Head of Partnerships at Big Think, Inc. from January 2019 to December 2021.
I served as an exit advisor to Big Think founders and the executive team.
I was a consultant during the successful sale of Big Think and its transition to the acquirer.
I created a new revenue stream called Big Think LIVE as part of the Covid-19 action plan.
I served as acting director of production during acquisition and integration.
I worked as VP - Global Media Licensing, Executive Interviews, Inc. from January 2018 to December 2019.
I created strategy, vision, and a sales process for a new line of business focusing on the thought leadership category.
I opened and managed the NYC office for a UK-based company.
I signed new media partners and managed licensing negotiations between media partners and organizations.
I worked as Owner of Preserve Media from January 2015 to December 2018.
I ran an online and brick and mortar video production/conversion business in Florida.
I negotiated strategic partnerships with UPS stores to sell videotape and film conversion as an add-on service.
I worked as Chief Revenue Officer at Planet High School from January 2014 to December 2015.
I developed a new revenue model selling local advertising on the platform.
I created a 50% back to school program of advertisers' choice.
I created a masterplan and built a local sales team in seven cities across three states.
I built the local sales team at breakneck speed.
I worked closely with the CTO in development of sales and marketing advertising portal on the platform.
I worked as Principal at Video Spokesmodel (VSM) from January 2011 to December 2013.
I acquired, scaled, and sold a widely recognized on-air talent marketplace as Principal at VSM.
I built an international network of green screen studios and freelance videographers to film talent in any location.
I founded and served as President of Visitors TV from January 2001 to December 2011.
I established, led, and sold Florida’s largest tourist television network serving travelers in hotels and airports.
I negotiated long-term contracts with major hotel brands, government agencies, and travel industry groups.
I managed operations, a creative team, and advertising sales efforts.
I led and negotiated an inbound acquisition of the company after a decade in business.
I have a Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations from Grand Valley State University.
I have skills in partner development and sales.
I have skills in business growth and development.
I have skills in media licensing and partnerships.
